groups.reason: The official callback delivers a POST notification with the NotifyMoiAttributeValueChanges request-body schema. Both generated POST operations deliver that same schema, so they correspond to the callback delivery under the operation/callback exception in R11-R12. Although their operationId is notifyMoiCreation, the body identifies the attribute-value-change delivery; correspondence follows the delivery rather than the misleading name.

joins.reason: This generated DELETE operation plays the role of the official DELETE resource operation: it has the same delete purpose, path parameters/scope, and success/error response roles. Its path is malformed or partial relative to the official full URL, but R1 permits correspondence for a broken copy when the operation role is otherwise the same; R3 identifies the operation by method and endpoint role.

This generated PUT is a duplicate form of the official PUT operation, with the same Resource request body and 200/201/204 response roles. The generated path incorporates the official server components into the path; under R1, appending the official server URL to its path yields the same endpoint address, and R3 preserves the PUT operation identity despite the changed location and operationId.

This generated DELETE is another form of the official DELETE operation, with the same resource-deletion purpose, path parameters, and 200/204 plus error response roles. Its server components are written in the path rather than separated as in the official document; R1 allows that URL split, and R3 identifies the same DELETE operation.
